title: Q 71 Nūḥ as lexical centroid/anchor of the Nūḥ-pericope cycle
rules_tuple: (no-tashkeel, QAC v0.4 ROOT, verse-union pericope, basmala-counted-only-in-Q1, Hafs-Kufan, Mashriqi)
direction_locked: Q71 most-central (Arm A rank==1) AND Q71 centrality > random-anchor null (Arm B z>0)
honest_note: Direction was LOCKED toward the intuitive Q71-as-centroid hypothesis. Q 71 is the longest pericope (L=28, 87 unique roots) and carries large private vocabulary blocks (cosmological signs vv15-20; the five named idols v23; the night/day complaint) that the short cross-surah retellings lack — which depresses lexical (Jaccard) centrality even if Q 71 is the NARRATIVE anchor of the cycle.
